name: Live TV Builder
description: Pick your country, postal code, provider lineup, and languages inside Jellyfin and the plugin wires up Live TV (an M3U tuner + XMLTV guide) pointing at Live TV Builder's auto-refreshing URLs. No copy-pasting of URLs.
overview: Auto-configure Jellyfin Live TV from a Live TV Builder lineup.
